mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, identity_type, source_app, external_id, verified_at, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM crm_customer_identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_identity (tenant_id, customer_id, identity_type, source_app, external_id, verified_at, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{identityType}, #{sourceApp}, #{externalId}, #{verifiedAt}, #{status})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM crm_customer_identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_identity SET customer_id = #{customerId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
